SELECT
	CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk) AS 'class_id',
	CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk, '-', si.id) AS 'HASH-ID',
    t.id as 'F_HASH_ID' ,
    now() as inserted_at,
    'elementary school' as discipline_id,
	concat(si.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk,'-' ,se.classroom_fk) as student_id,
    t.updated_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS scheduled_student_class_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.day END) AS total_faults_per_day
FROM `@{item().DatabaseName}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_documents_and_address sd ON sd.id = si.id
LEFT JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.class_faults cf ON cf.student_fk = si.id AND cf.schedule_fk = t.id
left join `@{item().DatabaseName}`.grade_results gr on se.student_fk = gr.enrollment_fk
WHERE t.unavailable = 0
GROUP BY c.id, si.id, t.month;

SELECT
	CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk, '-',si2.cep) as 'HASH_ID', 
	CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk) AS 'class_id', -- Pega o primeiro t.id vinculado ao c.id
	concat (se.classroom_fk, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk) as 'classroom_id',
	concat(se.school_inep_id_fk, '-', si2.cep) as school_id,
	concat(itd.instructor_fk, '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk) as 'teacher_id',
    t.id as 'F_HASH_ID' ,
    c.name,
    t.`month` ,
    c.school_year ,
    now() as inserted_at,
    t.updated_at as updated_at,
    'elementary school' as discipline_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS scheduled_student_class_days
FROM `@{item().DatabaseName}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.student_documents_and_address sd ON sd.id = si.id
LEFT JOIN `@{item().DatabaseName}`.class_faults cf ON cf.student_fk = si.id AND cf.schedule_fk = t.id
left join `@{item().DatabaseName}`.grade_results gr on se.student_fk = gr.enrollment_fk
left join `@{item().DatabaseName}`.instructor_teaching_data itd on c.id = itd.classroom_id_fk and se.school_inep_id_fk = itd.school_inep_id_fk 
left join `@{item().DatabaseName}`.school_identification si2 on se.school_inep_id_fk = si2.inep_id
WHERE t.unavailable = 0 and c.id is not null and t.id is not null and se.school_inep_id_fk is not null
GROUP BY c.id, t.month
order by c.id;

select
	c2.nome as CONTRATO,
	f.nome as FORNECEDOR,
	tdc.nome as "TIPO DE CONTRATO",
	F.respresentante_legal as "REPRESENTANTE LEGAL",
	r.descricao as RUBRICA,
	rf.parcelas as PARCELAS,
	RF.data_inicial as `DATA INICIAL`,
	RF.data_final as `DATA FINAL`,
	rf.valor_total as "VALOR TOTAL",
	rf.workload as "QUANTIDADE DE HORAS",
	rf.unitary_value as "VALOR UNITÁRIO",
	c2.apoiadora as 'APOIADOR',
	cdc.valor_total as 'VALOR TOTAL DOADO PELO APOIADOR',
	c2.origem_publica as 'ORIGEM PUBLICA',
	c.nome as 'Categoria Dos Gastos',
	rf.ordem as RUBRICA_FORNECEDORES_ORDEM,
	f.cnpj as FORNECEDOR_CNPJ,
	f.cpf as FORNECEDOR_CPF,
	a.ordem,
	a.data,
	a.valor
from
	fornecedor f
join rubrica_fornecedores rf on
	f.id = rf.fornecedor_fk
join rubrica r on
	rf.rubrica_fk = r.id
join tipo_de_contrato tdc on
	tdc.id = f.tipo_de_contrato_fk
join categoria c on
	c.id = r.categoria_fk
join centro_de_custo cdc on
	cdc.id = r.centro_de_custo_fk
join contrato c2 on
	cdc.contrato_fk = c2.id
join atividade a on
	a.rubrica_fornecedores_fk = rf.id
order by
	trim(c2.nome) asc,
	trim(f.nome) asc,
	rf.data_final

select
	c2.nome as CONTRATO,
	f.nome as FORNECEDOR,
	tdc.nome as "TIPO DE CONTRATO",
	F.respresentante_legal as "REPRESENTANTE LEGAL",
	r.descricao as RUBRICA,
	rf.parcelas as PARCELAS,
	RF.data_inicial as `DATA INICIAL`,
	RF.data_final as `DATA FINAL`,
	rf.valor_total as "VALOR TOTAL",
	rf.workload as "QUANTIDADE DE HORAS",
	rf.unitary_value as "VALOR UNITÁRIO",
	c2.apoiadora as 'APOIADOR',
	cdc.valor_total as 'VALOR TOTAL DOADO PELO APOIADOR',
	c2.origem_publica as 'ORIGEM PUBLICA'
from
	fornecedor f
join rubrica_fornecedores rf on
	f.id = rf.fornecedor_fk
join rubrica r on
	rf.rubrica_fk = r.id
join tipo_de_contrato tdc on
	tdc.id = f.tipo_de_contrato_fk
join categoria c on
	c.id = r.categoria_fk
join centro_de_custo cdc on
	cdc.id = r.centro_de_custo_fk
join contrato c2 on
	cdc.contrato_fk = c2.id
where
	(rf.data_final) >= now() 
group by trim(f.nome)
order  by sum(rf.valor_total) desc
